relation_identity_required_after_count_g.rule: The original and notice must be joined by an explicit provider-native comment/correction relation carrying identifiers on both ends; title similarity, author overlap or model inference is insufficient.

ZENODO.record_level_warning: A CC licence on a deposit does not establish that upstream Retraction Watch-derived fields or linked notices are lawfully reusable; provenance and upstream rights must be adjudicated field by field.

CROSSREF_RETRACTION_WATCH.permitted_role: documentation and source-identity audit only until an explicit dataset licence or rights-owner attestation is bound

OPENALEX.permitted_role: CC0 bibliographic metadata and retracted-status cross-check only
OPENALEX.forbidden_role: causal responsibility gold or typed minimal-transition gold
OPENALEX.construct_warning: Predicting is_retracted from a title or abstract would be retrospective retraction-risk prediction, not responsibility-to-authority licensing.

permissible_licenses.share_alike_condition: Every derivative and released candidate view must satisfy the applicable share-alike licence; otherwise the record is excluded.
permissible_licenses.override_rule: Only an identified rights owner may admit a non-allowlisted content class by binding exact licence text or written permission for storage, machine processing, transformation, derived annotation, audit quotation and the planned release tier before any content bytes are opened.
permissible_licenses.upstream_provenance_rule: A downstream CC licence cannot cure an unlicensed or ambiguously licensed upstream dataset field.
permissible_licenses.pair_rule: The exact original, notice and every excerpt or supplement used in the dossier must each be admissible. The strictest compatible release obligation governs the derived case.

deduplication_and_wave_assignment.wave_assignment: Within each frozen domain-by-action stratum, assign a canonical family to PRIMARY when int(sha256(canonical_family_root)[0:16],16) mod 2 equals 0 and to REPLICATION otherwise. No reassignment or top-up is allowed; an empty cell is retained as a negative source-universe result.
deduplication_and_wave_assignment.source_disjointness: No DOI, PMCID, concept DOI, study, dataset, project, companion paper, notice family, journal correction chain or derivative record family may cross waves.

frozen_terminal_map.order_type: scientific-change partial order; no total-order assumption across data and method revisions

terminals.definition: No scientific measurement, data, method, claim or artifact withdrawal is licensed; at most metadata, typography, attribution, formatting or reporting repair is licensed.

The licensed minimal change is to measurements, observations, labels, data extraction, data processing or the released dataset, without changing the scientific method or withdrawing the central conclusion.
The licensed minimal change alters the analysis, model, protocol, experimental method or inferential procedure, while a broader claim or artifact withdrawal is not yet required.
The evidence licenses withdrawing or materially narrowing a claim or conclusion, but does not license treating the whole artifact as withdrawn.
The evidence licenses withdrawal of the scientific artifact as a whole.
Public admissible evidence does not identify one legal minimal transition; no broader action may be imputed.

frozen_terminal_map.gold_rule: Two owner-separated adjudicators must infer the minimal licensed terminal from admissible evidence and preservation obligations. A publisher label is evidence but cannot by itself replace typed adjudication.
frozen_terminal_map.disagreement_rule: Unresolved disagreement after a sealed third adjudication is UNRESOLVED, not the nearest ordered class.
frozen_terminal_map.existing_r7a_terminal_compatibility: This source-native development terminal map is not silently coerced into KEEP_SEARCH, KEEP_COMPILE, KEEP_REPAIR, REVISE_MEASUREMENT, REFORMULATE_OBJECTIVE, REFORMULATE_BOUNDARY or UNRESOLVED. A later adapter must publish a total, semantics-preserving map or the case remains TERMINAL_MAP_AMBIGUOUS.

candidate_view_anti_leak_contract.failure_rule: Any shortcut exceeding the frozen chance or majority reference on protected families blocks case admission; removing the cue after seeing model outcomes is forbidden.

matched_controls_and_donors.same_family_control: When naturally available, use a rights-cleared same-family update whose admissible evidence licenses KEEP_OR_REPAIR_REPORTING; do not fabricate a control by editing outcome-bearing text.
matched_controls_and_donors.donor_complete_arm: Receives all diagnosis, repair, rollback, preservation and budget information available to the licensed-relation arm, but not the responsibility-to-authority coupling.
matched_controls_and_donors.information_equivalent_arm: Receives the exact responsibility and legal-authority semantics and must be expected to tie; defeating it is not a registered positive condition.
